name: r407_front
notes: The R-407's front (tools/blender/r407_trace.py). Main photo: r407_photos, an olx.ua sale listing (960 x 1280 px, square-on; not kept). Labels read off otechestvoussr.ru's 1920 px close-ups (r407_photos). Scale: the set 420 mm wide with its side latches (r407_to: 250 x 420 x 510 mm with the protruding parts; every photograph shows the front taller than wide). The flattened plate is 711 x 953 px; the set 878 px across its latches and about 1114 px tall with its folded handle and feet: 420 mm over the first gives 0.478 mm a pixel, 510 mm over the second 0.458; the mean, 0.468 (about 3 percent), makes the plate 332.9 x 446.1 mm.
